verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own backend docs say it can create a Payload-powered backend that includes authentication from a chat prompt, so auth scaffolding is a first-party capability. The evidence never describes sign-up/login flows, email-based auth, or social providers specifically, and no hands-on report confirms it works. Missing for 10: documented email sign-up/login flows, social/OAuth provider support, independent or hands-on corroboration of the generated auth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add user sign-up and login (email, social providers) scaffolded by the builder

citations.quote: Describe what you want to build in the chat, and Make can create a Payload-powered backend, including a database, file storage, authentication, and an admin panel.
The generated Payload and Next.js code is included in your Make project.
